title: Edge-of-Chaos
description: Falsifiable research programme and digital-twin metrology platform (Python + Rust) testing the necessary physical conditions for primary interoceptive sentience in continuous neuromorphic substrates.
notes: v0.2.1 aligns the predictive gain G_pred with its definition in the self-agency paper (P2, section 5.4): the efference-copy prediction is now scored against the observations, not against the target niche. The previous form made an ablated efference copy raise Psi instead of lowering it. The target niche and the dashboard ablation are now seeded. See CHANGELOG.md for details and known open issues.
